summary: Nu Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to the Market announcing the September 10, 2026 U.S. launch of a full financial-products suite and Nu Global, a multi-currency digital account. No securities, ownership, or control event is disclosed. Deposits are offered through FDIC-insured partner Lead Bank at 3.50% APY, alongside fee-free transfers, a 1.5% cashback card, and stablecoin yields. Nu applied for a national bank charter in 2025 and received preliminary conditional OCC approval in January 2026, launching via partner-bank model meanwhile. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor named; no risk-arb angle.
